macrosHelp.title: Understand my calculation
macrosHelp.intro: Your numbers don't come out of thin air — they're computed from standard nutrition formulas adapted to you.
macrosHelp.step1Body: How much energy your body burns at rest over 24 h, computed via the Mifflin-St Jeor formula from your sex, age, height, and weight.
macrosHelp.step2Body: Your BMR multiplied by an activity factor (sedentary, light, moderate, active, very active). It's what you really burn each day.
macrosHelp.step3Body: We tweak your TDEE based on your goal and intensity (gentle, moderate, intense). A health floor always keeps you from going too low.
macrosHelp.step4Body: Protein first in g/kg of body weight, fats as a % of calories (with a hormonal floor), and carbs fill the rest.
macrosHelp.step5Body: 35 ml of water per kilo of body weight, and +500 ml on training days.
macrosHelp.disclaimer: These recommendations are guidelines computed from standard formulas. They don't replace advice from a healthcare professional. If you're under medical care, pregnant, breastfeeding, or have a history of eating disorders, please consult before adjusting your nutrition.
